answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the harbor log reveals the live set and the willow audit records each lapse. Keeping 131 aliases alive hence means 131 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the opal quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 275 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
